dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the latest ornaments on sale...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: That's got to be the Wings of Oscillation.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: They are modeled after the slim wings of Crystalflies. The metallurgical process used to make them is quite unique, and they are encrusted with dazzling gems...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: They say that even the gentlest breeze will cause them to flap like real Crystalfly wings. To say that the Wings of Oscillation have taken high-class society by storm would be an understatement!

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: But though everyone loves chasing fads, I'd say that ornaments should be chosen according to their ability to bring out our unique characters.
